description: Guides, tools, and answers for precious-metals investors. Built and maintained by Bullion Trading LLC.
text:
The investor's reference for physical precious metals.
Structured learning paths, calculators that don't oversimplify, and a question-and-answer library
for everything in between. Designed for first-time buyers and people who already own bullion but
want to invest more deliberately.
Browse the guides
Shop bullion ↗
Learning paths
Each path is broken into short topics; each topic into 3–5 chunked parts you can read in 4–6 minutes.
New to Precious Metals
Start here. Four topics walk you through why people buy physical gold and silver, how much to allocate, which metals to pick, and when to enter the market.
